verdict.rationale: Hightouch's API guide says an API key can be scoped to a group so it lacks admin access, and gives the example of an AI tool using a key scoped to a group with the Workspace viewer role. That is least-privilege credentialing aimed directly at agents, built on bearer-token API keys and workspace permission boundaries. Missing for 10: scope granularity beyond group/role (per-resource or per-action scopes), key expiry/rotation/revocation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
